items.title: Gap Mangione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012
items.q: Oh I do remember Ray Alonge. He’s another incredible horn player.

ctx.x: He said go for it? Wow, what a memory. That was in a New York studio?
Yeah. Oh I do remember Ray Alonge. He’s another incredible horn player. Yeah. “Go for it.”
Nice. Yeah those are the — you had quite the ensemble there. Wow.
